steps.text: Tick—tick—tick—tick—
Tick—tick—tick—tick—
Tick—tick—tick—tick—
Bang.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Augh... shut up...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus, time to get up.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You're not even gonna answer?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No way you're thinking of lying in.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You sent me a message yesterday saying you were making rounds or something. That I should wake you up in the morning.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And here I am awake, and you're still sleeping. Haaah...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Eh, sleep in all you want. I'm gonna go rinse up.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus, you're still sleeping?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Wanna get up?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I just got back from field work myself. The mission wasn't easy. A huge hassle, actually. Not many people other than me could deal with it.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And Amiya gave me a hell of a lot of off days for it, so now I can sleep in for the whole day.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If I wasn't getting you up, I could've gotten a lot more sleep. Haaah...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Still asleep?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then I've got to do something or other.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You said yourself last night, you were one of the Medical Department's elite at this point. You can't be late. I'll drag you out if I have to.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Though saying that isn't a first for me...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But having the chance to actually drag you out from your covers would be.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hm-hmmm. What in the world would you do without me?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Still not getting up? I'm seriously gonna pull 'em. If you catch a cold, don't blame me.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibi—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus, what—what's up with you?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Why are your hands so hot?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus? Sis? Don't kid me like this. Haven't you always been pretty healthy?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Why would you just...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Sis! Sis! Say something!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm awake... Lava...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Stop shaking me...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Oh, s—sorry.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: A little chilly... and weak...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Probably caught a fever...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Fever? Your body can do that?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Oh, right!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Just wait for me a moment, I'll go and find a doctor for you right now!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's no big deal... Lava, you don't need to...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh... honestly, you...
Ten minutes later...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus, I found a doctor for you!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Ansel, you need to take a look quick! Is she alright?!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Wait, calm down—ack, stop pulling me like that—

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Good grief... I thought you had something urgent you needed to drag me out for. I see it was your sister.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's n... nothing...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The sick aren't qualified to say it's 'nothing.'

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Do you have a thermometer in your dormitory?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: We—We do!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In our household medicine box...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'll go and get it!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Don't rush.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's just... a fever...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Hrmm.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Temperature's a little high.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: And you're unable to exert strength?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mm-hm...
Medicine box! Come on! I remember it was here!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Have your diet and work-rest balance been fine these past few days?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Health...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Healthy meals.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Okay, forget I ever asked.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: You and Folinic are both the type that don't call for worrying.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: You've likely been too exhausted as of recent.
Found it!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do the necessary... tests too... in a bit, please...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That way she can... feel a little calmer...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Here, the thermometer!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Please bring the whole chest over. I can administer Hibiscus all the fundamental tests that way.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: A medical kit of hers should contain the necessary equipment.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: With sufficient supporting data, I'll be able to discern whether her high temperature is a protective bodily response, or whether some other symptom has had knock-on complications.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: We'll start with temperature. Here, open wide.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Aaah—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: H—How is she?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: No great cause for worry. Her body is just self-regulating somewhat aggressively.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Overexhaustion should be the main cause.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: As long as she rests up for the next few days, she'll be back again in no time.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: She'll want a bit of a lighter diet, reduced salt and sugar intake, and to pay mind to balanced nutrition.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So you're saying I've gotta make healthy meals for her...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The cafeteria can provide similar meals. You might not necessarily have to make them yourself.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: As for other major points, Hibiscus knows more than well enough, so I won't go listing.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: I'll file Hibiscus' sick leave for her at the Medical Department. Fang will tell the others.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: The both of you shouldn't have any field work or missions lined up for the next couple of days, correct.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I don't, no.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: None...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Then there shouldn't be any problem.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: If you don't have any particular questions, then I'll be on my way. I'll leave you to watch over her, Lava.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So I gotta look after you for a day or two, then.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I never took any sort of nursing class.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Lava... if you want to train... go train...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Your sister's... a doctor... she's not that weak...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: She can look after... herself...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: *Cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That's enough out of you! Does your throat hurt? Do you need some water?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's okay...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Look, I, uh, I wasn't—I'm not saying I don't wanna look after you!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's just, that, I, I don't really have experience...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So if I get any part wrong. If you're uncomfortable.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then tell me.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Lava...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then we're doing this. You need to eat breakfast first. I'll go make some in a moment. I'll do the dishes after we're done.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is your appetite gonna be a problem?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It won't...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Want me to get a washbowl first, then, so you can wash your face and stuff?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Just give me a moment.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Pulls at a corner of Lava's hem)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Oh. Is there anything else?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Mouths a 'thank you')

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nothing to thank me for. You got ill. I'm off for a couple days. It pretty much works out.
Uh, where'd that washbowl from before go?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Phew... finally, all done...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Jeez, nursing's rougher than I thought. I don't feel cool at all.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If you asked me to do this in front of everyone else, I'd refuse point blank.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Are you full?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then you can go back to sleep now.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Close your eyes, and get some proper rest.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'll wash out the bowl, and then I'll go do the dishes, and then—not sure.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Eh, anyhow, for now that's that. If you need anything, set the alarm on this clock to go off. I'll come right over when I hear it.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Be good.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Pats Hibiscus's face)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mmnn... brush, washing-up liquid.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Did I give Hibiscus's face a pat just then?)
Mum and dad'll miss you.
Don't forget to write to us.
Be good.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Mum and dad love treating us like that.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Not sure if they've gotten the letter from last week yet.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Mm... is that how Hibiscus treats me too?)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You need to eat healthy meals.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Be good.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Whenever she acts like that, chances are she's trying to boss me around.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I don't know if that one bowl of meat porridge was enough to fill her.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Should I peel her a piece of fruit too?)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Or maybe roast some meat?)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I really wanna set up a stove right by her bed and barbecue meat for myself.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Make her starve drooling.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Let's go with peeling fruit, yeah...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I sliced some fruit for you. Do you want it?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Zzz...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Sleeping pretty heavy, huh.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Weird, actually, how she doesn't look all that loathsome when she's asleep.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Pinches Hibiscus's face)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Zzz...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Still running high.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hope she'll recover a little soon. That way I can prank her with a completely clean conscience.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Haaah... I've been busy half the day. I'm a little tired myself now...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Guess I can nap a little by her side...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Zzz...
Tick—tick—tick—tick—
Tick—tick—tick—tick—
Tick—tick—tick—tick—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Huh?!
Tick—tick—tick—tick—
Bang.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Did that wake you up? Sorry...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's the alarm I set for your porridge.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do you want it right now, or in a bit?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Now, I guess.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Lemme get it.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ah-ah-ah, don't get up. You knocked out all the way from yesterday to today and now you want to be up and about?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Lie—down—for—me.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Weagh...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (When did Hibiscus get this strong?)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I asked around a little. It was Pith who got you into this state after taking you out for special training.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: This isn't Miss Pith's fault.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: This was going to be a high-intensity training session, anyway. It might look pretty ruthless at first, but nothing ever starts smooth. I'll be fine after I'm used to it.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Still, you can't wreck yourself with training like this...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I think it's worth it. I can feel how I'm getting stronger, Originium Arts precision or otherwise, training like this.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Besides...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Besides?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I was warned about this training, going into it. It'd be majorly intense, it'd be tough making it through and I'd need a good mentality and so on.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I told the instructors: 'It's fine. My sister's a medic. Even if I end up half dead, as long as I still have breath in me, she'll bring me back.'

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: More or less how it went. You get the idea.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Lava.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll overlook it this time, but if you end up like this after special training again, I'll officially raise dissent with the HR department.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You don't need to—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I don't care what kind of improvement you might get out of this. It only matters to me whether this is going to damage your health.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No matter what, you can't...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus? Sis?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't—don't cry. C'mon, look at how big you are.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do you know how worried I was when I found you?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm alright, aren't I...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Just a little overdraft on my strength. And a few grazes.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: No, not this...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do you still remember... how you ended up at Rhodes Island...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I helped a bunch of merchants repel some bandits, and someone noticed I was an Infected...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then their caravan dumped me... and I remember someone or other bashed my head in. Then I passed out.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And when I woke up again, I was aboard Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: And somebody'd healed my injuries.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I heard an operator in the field picked me up on the way back? Lucky thing I was only minorly injured. Wasn't much trouble for others.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: They were heavy injuries...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I thought, after I lost touch with you, the next time we met, you'd still be the same awkward you, but...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Then you were on the operating table, Lava—burnt up like a fireball...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I couldn't... do anything to help...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The only thing I could do was—attend to you after the operation... just like now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You were—crying my name, non-stop, in your bed...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What? Wait, I never heard about this before...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Then—Then why didn't you tell me—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Because I knew you'd act out if you got awkward! It was so tough just finding you. What if you just ran away again?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: So before you recovered and officially came on board, I didn't even dare show up.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I'm not—I'm not that unreasonable.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Of course you are!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You got lost when we left Victoria BECAUSE you were being so difficult, Lava!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That—That was an accident...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In any case, you can't let anything like this happen again. Do you understand?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Quietly) Okay...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mm-hm. There's a good girl.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, that's right. What were you dreaming about?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you don't mind, you're safe to share some of your dreams with your sister. It'll be good for your recuperation.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mm-hm. I'm listening.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I... I saw...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What did you see?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I saw you...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Was there anything about me?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You were...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Go on. I'm listening.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (Pats Lava's face)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hmuh?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Go on, then. What did you dream of?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I can't, this is too embarrassing! I can't say it!)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nothing!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nothing at all!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Be good.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I won't!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I didn't have a single dream!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: How can you be so difficult right after waking up, Lava?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Being difficult isn't anything new. Why is your face so red, though?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Did you manage to get a fever too?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nope!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Just lie down now, and I'll take your temperature.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What do you need my temperature for?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't bring the thermometer over, I don't have a fever! It's nothing!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The sick aren't qualified to say it's 'nothing.'

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Can't you tell the difference between a fever and blushing?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Why would I be making you blush?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Be—Because it'd be so embarrassing having to tell you how you were so ill in my dream you couldn't even speak, duh!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That's more... or less how it went...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Heheh. Hearing that actually makes me pretty happy.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's because usually... like, sis, you're...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'd never be taken out that easily.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mm, but it's always hard to expect the unexpected. So in future, I really might need you to look after me, Lava.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Of course, I've always believed you'll be there to help your sister out in bad times.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Even if you usually never listen and you're always so obstinate, you have plenty of ideas, and you're always fast to act.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is this just a really roundabout way of criticizing me...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It isn't.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Do you have anything to eat? I'm a little hungry.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Yep, I do.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: This is wonderful. It's not everyday we can get along so well.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Just wait a moment. I'll bring it over for you.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (So back then, she was there too, huh.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I wondered why there was a voice that sounded so familiar.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (If not for Mr. Johann teaching me, Hibiscus wouldn't have seen me again...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I've got no idea how he's doing these days in Leithanien. Someone as talented at music as him probably got famous by now.)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Maybe a letter...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (I don't know when mum and dad'll send a reply...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Everyone's... going through really rough times...)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (If I could just be more powerful, then...)

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Here we go, now. Here's some porridge, fresh off the flame. Eat it while it's hot.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Sniffs it)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It doesn't really smell like anything. Isn't it meat porridge?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In your dreams, it was. This is cutting-edge healthy porridge. Healthy AND tasty!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: (Healthy?!)

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You—wait, hold on, did you put in that weird healthy powder or whatever it was you made?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's right. It'll be easier to absorb, and faster to deliver nutrients to your body.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let me just ask, first... have you tasted it yourself...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Of course I have~

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I eat three square meals a day, and my nutrition's especially well-balanced. That's why it's you who gets ill and not your sister, you know.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Here, try it. Healthiness is the most important thing.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I don't wanna. I'm not gonna have a single spoonful.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I went to a lot of pains improving it. Just give it a try.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Like I'm gonna trust you! You said you improved it last time, and it still wasn't—

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Here!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Wmmhphh!!!!!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mmph?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's like it... tastes... kind of tolerable now?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Riiight~

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Eugh, no.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nononono, what's up with this aftertaste?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Urp—don't tell me you just delayed the taste and called that better!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's right. You can drink all the porridge in one gulp now, can't you?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hibiscus, we are NOT done!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Bleuch...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mark my words! I am... eugh... NOT done with you!
